values.zh-CN: 齐次坐标的代表元不变性

values.en: If $\lambda\in\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}$ and $(X,Y,Z)$ is a nonzero triple, then the triples $(X,Y,Z)$ and $(\lambda X,\lambda Y,\lambda Z)$ determine the same homogeneous coordinates, that is $X:Y:Z=\lambda X:\lambda Y:\lambda Z$ in $\mathbb{P}^2_{\mathbb{R}}$. This is the invariance that makes homogeneous coordinates well defined on the projective point rather than on a chosen representative.
values.zh-CN: 若 $\lambda\in\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}$ 且 $(X,Y,Z)$ 为非零三元组，则 $(X,Y,Z)$ 与 $(\lambda X,\lambda Y,\lambda Z)$ 确定同一齐次坐标，即在 $\mathbb{P}^2_{\mathbb{R}}$ 中有 $X:Y:Z=\lambda X:\lambda Y:\lambda Z$。正是这一不变性使齐次坐标定义在射影点上，而非定义在某个取定的代表元上。
